module_summary: Three-state Mealy FSM detecting overlapping 101 on x, with async active-low reset and z asserted from state S10 when x is 1.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: 2-bit sequence-detector state (S, S1, S10) driving next-state and Mealy output.

anchors.name: z
anchors.why: Mealy detect output, equals x in state S10.

anchors.name: x
anchors.why: Serial input bit stream scanned for the 101 sequence.

groups.name: sequence_detector_fsm
groups.description: State register, next-state logic on x and Mealy output z.
